description: Buildings and facilities that owe a legally required inspection, filing or fix (SB 721 balcony inspections, LA energy benchmarking, open code cases, soft-story and concrete retrofits, industrial stormwater permits), read from the agency's dataset and refreshed daily. Free: what each law requires, who may sign, how many are on each list, by ZIP and status. For the firms that do this work. Not for finding or profiling people.

list.description: Optional list id for its full numbers, e.g. sb721-cited. Leave out to see every list.
